name: check_availability
description: Returns open appointment slots for one of the business's calendars. Only call it when scheduling_enabled is true. Pick the calendar from scheduling_calendars that matches what the caller wants to book; if more than one could match, ask which before calling. Call it before ever naming a time to the caller — never offer a slot this tool did not return. Express the preferred_date relative to current_datetime: the caller's 'tomorrow' is a concrete date, compute it, do not pass the word.

calendar_id.description: The id of the chosen calendar, copied exactly from scheduling_calendars.

preferred_date.description: The date the caller asked about, as YYYY-MM-DD in the calendar's timezone.
